[[Kenric the Believer]] is a [[White Mantle]] [[boss]] that is part of the expedition seeking to gain access to the [[Henge of Denravi]] ahead of the [[Shining Blade]].

== Missions ==
* [[Maguuma Jungle]]
** {{NPC location|Aurora Glade}}

== Skills ==
He has 15 in [[Blood Magic]] in [[Normal mode]].
* {{skill icon|Mark of Subversion}}
* {{skill icon|Order of Pain}}
* {{skill icon|Vampiric Gaze}}
* {{skill icon|Well of the Profane}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[White Mantle Badge]]

== Notes ==
* Kenric may randomly spawn in one of the points marked on the map.  He shares them with [[Holt the Iron Boot Heel]], [[Cuthbert the Chaste]], [[Garr the Merciful]], [[Lars the Obeisant]], and [[Manton the Indulgent]].  As such, there is a chance that Kenric will not spawn at all.
* Well of the Profane is a skill that may be beneficial to [[Signet of Capture|capture]] from Kenric in this mission, since it will only become available as a quest reward of [[The Misplaced Sword]] later in [[Heroes' Audience]] within the [[Crystal Desert]].
* Order of Pain is also not available until one reaches the [[skill trainer]] in [[Port Sledge]] of the [[Southern Shiverpeaks]].
